Test Case Description: Verify Group Maintenance module loads successfully
Preconditions: User is logged in with access to MicroFinance module
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Start > MicroFinance > Group Maintenance | 2. Wait for page load completion | 3. Verify sidebar main form and action panel are visible
Expected Result: Group Maintenance screen loads without console errors and core sections are visible

Test Case Description: Verify default branch value is loaded from session
Preconditions: Valid branch exists in user session
Test Steps: 1. Open Group Maintenance screen | 2. Observe Branch ID field
Expected Result: Branch ID is prefilled from session and can be used for lookup and view actions

Test Case Description: Verify branch lookup search and selection
Test Steps: 1. Click Branch lookup icon | 2. Search for a valid branch | 3. Select a record
Expected Result: Selected branch ID and branch name are populated correctly

Test Case Description: Verify center lookup is available in view mode
Test Steps: 1. Keep form in view mode | 2. Click Center lookup icon | 3. Select an existing center
Expected Result: Center ID and center name are populated and record can be viewed

Test Case Description: Verify View action loads existing group details
Preconditions: Valid branch and center are selected
Test Steps: 1. Click View | 2. Wait for data load | 3. Review fields in all sections
Expected Result: All persisted group details are loaded and form remains non-editable

Test Case Description: Verify Add action requires branch selection
Test Steps: 1. Clear branch field | 2. Click Add
Expected Result: System blocks add mode and shows validation message for required branch

Test Case Description: Verify Add mode field behavior and button states
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Observe field editability and action buttons
Expected Result: Editable fields become enabled while Center ID stays readonly and Save Cancel become active

Test Case Description: Verify center name is editable only in Add mode
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Check center name field | 3. Cancel | 4. Load record and click Edit | 5. Check center name field
Expected Result: Center name is editable in Add mode and readonly in Edit mode as per business rule

Test Case Description: Verify center lookup is disabled in Add mode
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Try clicking Center lookup icon
Expected Result: Center lookup is blocked in Add mode because group ID will be system generated

Test Case Description: Verify required field validation on Save in Add mode
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Leave mandatory fields empty | 3. Click Save
Expected Result: System prevents save and identifies required fields including center name and core dates

Test Case Description: Create new group with valid data
Preconditions: User is in Add mode with valid branch
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid mandatory details | 2. Click Save | 3. Observe success notification
Expected Result: Group is created successfully with system generated center ID and data persists

Test Case Description: Verify success message contains generated group ID
Test Steps: 1. Save a new group | 2. Observe success toast/message area
Expected Result: Success message includes the created Group ID for user reference

Test Case Description: Verify Edit action requires loaded center
Preconditions: No center record is currently loaded
Test Steps: 1. Open module fresh | 2. Click Edit
Expected Result: System blocks edit operation and prompts user to load a center first

Test Case Description: Edit existing group and save changes
Preconditions: Existing center is loaded in view mode
Test Steps: 1. Click Edit | 2. Change editable fields such as meeting details | 3. Click Save
Expected Result: Record updates successfully and latest values are visible in view mode

Test Case Description: Cancel behavior in Add mode clears entered data
Preconditions: User is in Add mode with unsaved values
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Enter sample values | 3. Click Cancel
Expected Result: Form resets to clean state and add/edit flags are cleared

Test Case Description: Cancel behavior in Edit mode reloads persisted record
Preconditions: Existing record is loaded and modified in Edit mode
Test Steps: 1. Click Edit | 2. Modify fields without saving | 3. Click Cancel
Expected Result: Unsaved values are discarded and original server values are reloaded

Test Case Description: Delete action requires loaded center
Test Steps: 1. Attempt Delete without loading center
Expected Result: System prevents delete and shows validation prompt

Test Case Description: Delete existing group with confirmation
Preconditions: Existing center is loaded with delete permission
Test Steps: 1. Click Delete | 2. Confirm in dialog | 3. Observe result
Expected Result: Record is deleted successfully and form is cleared with focus returned to Branch ID

Test Case Description: Verify section collapse and expand interactions
Test Steps: 1. Toggle each section header once to collapse | 2. Toggle again to expand
Expected Result: Section content visibility changes correctly and icon state updates

Test Case Description: Verify sidebar section expand and collapse behavior
Test Steps: 1. Expand Data Entry and View groups | 2. Collapse them back
Expected Result: Sidebar groups open and close reliably without breaking layout

Test Case Description: Verify sidebar submodule search filtering
Test Steps: 1. Type 'Group' in submodule search | 2. Verify filtered items | 3. Clear search
Expected Result: Only matching submodules are shown and clear restores full list

Test Case Description: Verify opening child submodule iframe from sidebar
Test Steps: 1. Click a sidebar item such as Group Details | 2. Observe iframe transition
Expected Result: Child form opens in inline iframe and main form is hidden after transition

Test Case Description: Verify closing child submodule returns to main form
Test Steps: 1. Trigger close child action | 2. Wait for close animation
Expected Result: Main form becomes visible again and iframe source resets to about:blank

Test Case Description: Verify Group Class dropdown is populated and selectable
Test Steps: 1. Open Group Class dropdown | 2. Select a value
Expected Result: Dropdown contains valid options with --Select-- placeholder and selected value persists in edit state

Test Case Description: Verify Meeting Day and Status dropdown behavior
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode
Test Steps: 1. Select Meeting Day | 2. Change Status Active and Inactive
Expected Result: Selected values are retained and available for save payload

Test Case Description: Verify meeting date business sequence validation
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode
Test Steps: 1. Enter Formation Date later than First Meeting Date | 2. Attempt Save
Expected Result: System enforces valid business date sequence and blocks invalid save

Test Case Description: Verify status reason handling when status is Inactive
Test Steps: 1. Set Status to Inactive | 2. Leave Status Reason empty | 3. Click Save
Expected Result: System enforces status reason requirement for inactive groups if configured by business rule

Test Case Description: Verify backend integration for save payload fields
Preconditions: Browser dev tools network tab is available
Test Steps: 1. Perform Add or Edit save | 2. Inspect save request payload
Expected Result: Payload includes required identifiers and group data fields expected by API contract

Test Case Description: Verify backend integration for delete API call
Preconditions: Existing record loaded with delete permission
Test Steps: 1. Click Delete and confirm | 2. Inspect delete request and response
Expected Result: Delete API is called once with correct branch and group identifiers and returns success

Test Case Description: Verify audit fields render for viewed record
Test Steps: 1. Click View for an existing record | 2. Inspect Behind the Scene audit items
Expected Result: Created and modified metadata are displayed when available without becoming editable

Test Case Description: Verify Group Snapshot fields stay read-only
Test Steps: 1. View group snapshot section | 2. Try editing total and balance fields
Expected Result: Snapshot metrics remain read-only to preserve derived business values

Test Case Description: Verify center product lookup and selected value persistence
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode
Test Steps: 1. Click Center Product lookup | 2. Select product | 3. Save and reload
Expected Result: Product ID and name persist correctly after save and subsequent view

Test Case Description: Verify credit officer and group formed by lookups
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode
Test Steps: 1. Use Credit Officer lookup | 2. Use Group Formed By lookup | 3. Save
Expected Result: Selected user IDs and names are accepted and persisted

Test Case Description: Verify branch change resets center context safely
Test Steps: 1. Load a center record | 2. Change Branch ID | 3. Attempt View without reselecting center
Expected Result: System avoids cross-branch stale center context and prompts for valid center selection

Test Case Description: Verify toast notifications for success and validation events
Test Steps: 1. Trigger one validation error | 2. Trigger one successful save
Expected Result: Toast messages appear in toast container with clear feedback for each event

Test Case Description: Verify access control for unauthorized user
Preconditions: Login with user lacking Group Maintenance rights
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Group Maintenance URL directly
Expected Result: System denies access or renders read-only behavior based on authorization policy
